integrity: The finite classification has an elementary proof through the binary derivative and zero-bin \(\ell_1\) geometry, and the bundled standalone verifier independently reconstructs direct repetition descendants and exhaustively checks every layer equality case. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for arbitrary binary length \(6\) codes correcting up to two tandem duplications of length \(1\); no claim is made for larger length, larger alphabets, longer duplicated blocks, or symmetry-orbit classification. A residual originality risk remains for obscure or unindexed historical small-parameter enumerations.
title: Exact binary length-six two-repetition codes and all equality cases
